name: mirage
text:
That limit applies to bets by hand too, not only the auto-bet. Kalshi's "Most per day" chip is the cap, and it counts auto-bets and your hand bets together. The refusal means today's Kalshi stakes plus this bet would pass $25. The Kalshi default is $50, so the chip was probably set to $25 at some point.

To raise it, open the Kalshi tab > Auto and tap $50, $100, $250 or $500 under "Most per day". It takes effect on the next bet. The $25 that already went out today still counts toward the new total.
